Apply SOLID principles: cohesive modules; extend without modifying; substitutable subclasses; focused interfaces; abstraction-based dependencies. Avoid duplicating logic and functionality across multiple files. Refactor repetitive code blocks into reusable components. Document reusable components clearly. Strive for simplicity; minimize complexity; Avoid over-engineering solutions. Prioritize readability, understandability, quality, maintainability, and testability. Only implement functionality that is currently required. Don't introduce features or code that is not explicitly needed. Focus on delivering working code, not anticipating future requirements.

Use consistent formatting/style, 2-space indentation, meaningful names, clear file names, judicious comments for complex logic, and docstrings
